title: Anenji 4200 Protocol 1 owner A/B comparison of battery-type writes
summary: The owner reports an empty FC06 response at register 322 on 8ab3664 and successful changes on patched beta.5. That driver's write_holding path used FC16 despite the declared FC06; this also corrects the attribution of the earlier register-425 observation. No successful FC16 packet capture or completed equalization cycle was reported.
